name: Litopys
description: World-lore keeper for roleplay chats. SCRIBE pass (frequent): extracts world facts (places, NPCs, items, events, lore), chronicle events and a running story recap into data/litopys/store.json and renders human-readable data/vault-chats/<character>.md. CURATOR pass (rare): dedupes, merges, retires played-out facts; safe ops auto-apply, risky ones go to a proposals queue for approval in the Litopys panel. Formerly Archivarius: reads data/archivarius/* until its first save, and an Archivarius copy left beside it no longer runs.
